# Synthetic compatibility fixture

`v03-camp.sav.gz` was generated by the released 0.3 ROM's acceptance playthrough in mGBA, using only button inputs. It is a 128 KiB native flash save compressed with gzip. It contains a default-seed camp, a bed/roof/planting plot, test resources and five recruited Pokemon. It contains no user save data.

`tools/check_controls.py` loads a disposable copy to verify that 0.3.1 can open and save an existing 0.3 world while exercising the revised UI. The fixture is not a save state.
